user_problem: Flagged unusual values need consistent human review without automatic deletion or unsupported causal explanations.
unique_output: A packet listing each flagged record, triggering supplied rule, relevant context, disposition options, and evidence gaps.
required_input: Records, explicit outlier rules, allowed context fields, and permitted review dispositions.
critical_rule: An outlier flag is not an error finding; preserve values and avoid attributing causes without evidence.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is duplicate-record-triage; this packages unusual-value review rather than evaluating possible record matches.
acceptance_scenario: Input values 10, 12, 99; rule flags values above 50; dispositions retain, correct-with-source, exclude-with-reason. Output creates one review item for 99, cites the threshold, and makes no correction.
